name: AIOD Discounts & Free Gift
description:
AIOD connects Claude to Shopify promotion and discount workflows.

Use natural language to work with automatic discounts, discount codes, free gifts with purchase, BOGO / Buy X Get Y offers, volume and quantity discounts, tiered promotions, fixed-price offers, shipping discounts and advanced conditional discount rules.

AIOD is designed for Shopify merchants who need promotion logic beyond Shopify's standard discount setup. Rules can include conditions based on cart value, product or collection, quantity, customer, market and other supported Shopify attributes.

Example requests:
 “Create 10% off when customers buy 3 or more items.”
 “Give a free gift when the cart reaches $150.”
 “Create a BOGO offer for this collection.”
 “Give VIP customers 20% off, excluding sale products.”
 “Create a tiered offer: spend $100 get 10% off, spend $200 get 20% off.”

AIOD is built on Shopify's discount infrastructure and gives ecommerce and marketing teams a conversational way to create and manage sophisticated promotional logic without writing custom code.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AIOD Discounts & Free Gift to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AIOD Discounts & Free Gift to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aiod-automatic-discount.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AIOD Discounts & Free Gift MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIOD Discounts & Free Gift provides these MCP tools: shopify_discount_config_schema, shopify_discount_docs_search, shopify_discount_draft, shopify_discount_find, shopify_discount_get, shopify_discount_performance, and shopify_discount_publish.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AIOD Discounts & Free Gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AIOD Discounts & Free Gift in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does AIOD Discounts & Free Gift MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIOD Discounts & Free Gift requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops AIOD Discounts & Free Gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIOD Discounts & Free Gift is developed by 247 Apps Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
